speaker: Doctor

text: My main symptom is The presence of a rough, scaly, sandpaper-like plaque on the left dorsal hand. I also have No tenderness, No pain.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Given the rough, scaly appearance on a sun-exposed area in a patient with significant sun history, this is highly suggestive of actinic keratosis. I will proceed to confirm the diagnosis visually.
